written.description: Gathers several separate AI security scans behind one console: the agent, the MCP servers, the skills, the serving infrastructure, and a jailbreak pass against the model itself.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(skill-scan): deterministic result for non-standard skill packages (#725)

Two zips each holding a single .docx produced inconsistent outcomes (issue #723): one scan finished with status=done / score=100 while the other died with status=error, because the verdict hinged on whether the LLM happened to call the finish tool for content it could not audit anyway.

Add a static gate in Agent.scan(): packages with no SKILL.md (case-insensitive, any depth) and only non-auditable binary files (documents / media / archives such as .docx, .pdf, .png, .zip) now return a deterministic not-a-skill-package result (score=100, empty findings, bilingual reason) before any LLM call, mirroring the existing empty-project path. Extensionless files (LICENSE, Makefile, Dockerfile) count as auditable text; bytecode (.pyc/.pyo/.pyd) stays auditable per issues #630/#631.

Local verification (isolated checkout at head c67fd1e):
- New regression tests in pytests/test_non_skill_package.py (7 tests) all pass.
- Full skill-scan suite: 129 passed (122 existing + 7 new), no regression.
- go build ./... clean (PR is Python-only).
- All CI check-runs green (Build and test Go packages, CodeQL, Analyze go/python, GITHUB_OPENSOURCE_SCAN_PIPELINE).

Fixes #723 (complete fix — issue closed by this merge).

Co-authored-by: boy-hack <boy-hack@users.noreply.github.com>
